battle.name: 杜伏威擊陳稜之戰
battle.brief: 隋大業十三年（617）秋，江淮起義首領杜伏威在淮南一線迎擊隋廷鎮壓名將陳稜的軍隊，設伏破其精兵，陳稜僅以身免；杜乘勝破高郵，進取歷陽自稱總管。卡面的羅馬方陣盾屬公元前後羅馬軍團裝備，並未出現在此役，隋軍實用圓盾方盾配長槊與明光鎧，義軍則靠水網游擊與火攻取勝。

kit.name: 羅馬方陣盾
kit.history: 凸面的長方盾。羅馬的防線靠盾緣咬住盾緣，不是靠盾牌多厚。

countries: 本役是隋朝末年長江下游北岸一場由起義軍擊破朝廷鎮壓軍的遭遇戰，時間在隋大業十三年（617），戰場在淮南與江北一線。交戰一方是杜伏威率領的江淮起義軍。杜伏威原是章丘長白山的山賊首領，大業九年（613）在淮南起事，兼併苗海潮、趙破陣等部，屯兵六合，直逼江都；其軍以鄉兵、農民與漁戶為骨幹，輔以水鄉舟船，編制鬆散而行動迅速，賞罰不私，士卒樂於效死。另一方是隋朝中央派出的鎮壓大軍，主將陳稜是隋廷倚重的名將，所部為中樞直屬精兵與沿途郡縣之兵，兵種齊備，騎兵、弩手、步卒與攻城器械兼備，但在缺了騎兵縱橫的開闊地、只剩水網縱橫的江南，反而束手束腳。背景裡的第三方包括：控制吳郡的沈法興、據江陵武昌的蕭銑、據浙東的李子通等割據勢力，以及長安新立的唐朝。陳稜敗後，隋廷已無力再大舉深入江淮，江南局勢遂由起義軍與起義軍之間的爭奪主導。
countriesEn: This was an engagement fought in the north bank of the lower Yangtze in 617, at the end of the Sui, in which a rebel army broke a field army dispatched by the imperial court to put it down. One side was the Jianghuai rebel host led by Du Fuwei. Du was originally a bandit chief of the Changbai mountains in Zhangqiu, raised his men in the Huai region in the ninth year of Daye (613), absorbed the bands of Miao Haichao and Zhao Pozhen, and posted his troops at Liuhe, pressing right up to Jiangdu. His force rested on village levies, farmers and fishermen, stiffened by the boats of the water towns, loosely organised but quick to move, with rewards and punishments fairly administered, so that his men were glad to die for him. The other side was the large suppression army sent out by the centre of the Sui court, commanded by Chen Leng, a general on whom the court relied heavily. His troops were the picked men of the central army together with the county levies gathered along the route, a complete order of battle of cavalry, crossbowmen, foot soldiers and siege equipment; but deprived of the open ground on which cavalry needs to manoeuvre, and left with nothing but a maze of water in the south, they were hampered at every turn. Among the third parties standing around the two were Shen Faxing, who held Wuzhou, Xiao Xian, who held Jiangling and Wuchang, Li Zitong, who held eastern Zhejiang, and the new Tang state at Chang'an. After Chen Leng's defeat the Sui court could no longer mount a serious campaign in the Jianghuai, and control of the south passed increasingly to the rebel armies and to the wars between them.
people: 核心人物是杜伏威（583至623年），名堯，字伏威，齊州章丘（今山東濟南章丘）人。少年時與輔公祏相識相善，兩人因盜案落草，年僅十六，其後於大業九年（613）在章丘東北長白山聚眾起義，轉戰淮南。史載他治軍能與將士同甘共苦，所獲財物悉數賞賜將士，戰死者亦得撫恤，故士卒爭效死力；他又減賦稅、廢殉葬、懲貪污，在隋末亂世中為自己爭來兵源與民心。輔公祏是他自少年結交的刎頸之交，被任為長史，統攝軍政，本役中率精兵擔任伏擊任務；但武德六年（623），輔公祏在杜伏威入朝後假稱奉命起兵反唐，兵敗被殺，杜伏威亦因憂懼同年三月病卒，虛歲四十一。隋方主將陳稜以鎮壓江淮義軍聞名，是隋廷在江南最後一位能獨當一面的將領，本役遭重創後再無力反攻。與本役前後相連的隋方人物，還有大業十二年（616）在鹽城被全滅的虎牙郎將公孫上哲，以及被杜伏威用火攻燒死在蘆葦蕩的江都留守校尉宋顥；對面的則是越王楊侗、唐高祖李淵，以及與杜伏威爭地的李子通。
peopleEn: The central figure was Du Fuwei (583 to 623), whose given name was Yao and who went by the style Fuwei, a native of Zhangqiu in Qi prefecture, present-day Zhangqiu district of Jinan in Shandong. As a boy he befriended Fu Gongshi; the two of them went into the mountains as thieves after a theft case, when they were only sixteen, and later, in the ninth year of Daye (613), raised men in the Changbai mountains northeast of Zhangqiu and carried the war into the Huai region. The histories record that he shared the hardships of his soldiers, handed over all the plunder and all the goods his men had taken, and provided for the families of the fallen, so that the rank and file fought to the death for him; he also cut taxes, abolished the burial of retainers with their masters and punished corruption, and in a collapsing age that won him recruits and goodwill. Fu Gongshi was his sworn friend from boyhood, appointed changshi and given charge of military and civil affairs; in this campaign he led the picked troops in the ambush. But in the sixth year of Wude (623), after Du Fuwei had been summoned to court, Fu Gongshi falsely claimed that he had been ordered to raise troops against the Tang, was defeated and killed, and Du Fuwei died of fear and illness in the third month of that same year, aged forty-one by Chinese reckoning. The Sui commander was Chen Leng, famous for putting down the rebels of the Jianghuai, the last man in the south the Sui court could trust to act on his own; badly hit in this campaign, he never campaigned there again. Other Sui officers connected with the campaign, before and after, are the tiger-tooth langjiang Gong Sun Shangzhe, whose force was wiped out at Yancheng in 616, and Song Hao, the Jiangdu garrison officer whom Du Fuwei burned to death in a reed marsh. On the other side stood the Prince of Yue Yang Tong, the Tang founder Li Yuan, and Li Zitong, who fought Du Fuwei for the same ground.
kits: 卡面兵器是羅馬方陣盾（Scutum），羅馬共和晚期至帝國時期軍團步卒所配的凸面長方盾，上下略作弧曲，可護住軀幹至大腿上方；其要義不在厚重，而在盾緣相接、整列互相咬合，合成一面可以移動的牆，盾手貼近成列，長槊自盾上緣探出，短兵在盾後動手。必須說明，羅馬帝國在五世紀已亡，這面盾在617年的江淮戰場上並不曾出現，此役雙方所持是中國式的盾與槊。隋軍步卒用圓盾與方盾，多蒙牛皮或髹漆，與環首刀、直刀相配；精銳步卒與騎兵用馬槊、長槊，鎧甲以明光鎧配兜鍪、札甲。弓弩分為角弓、臂弩，野戰與守城都備蹶張弩與床弩；水網地帶另有舟船、蒙衝、拍竿與走馬樓船，攻城用雲梯、撞車、投石，防守有雉堞、櫓與拒馬。火攻器材如火炬、油料，對付蘆葦蕩與舟船格外要緊。糧秣、兵員與援軍全靠運河漕運，誰控住邗溝沿線的渡口與倉場，誰就控住戰局。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the Roman scutum, the large convex rectangular shield carried by legionary infantry from the late Republic into the imperial period, curved slightly at the top and bottom so that it covered the body down to the top of the thighs. Its point lay not in thickness but in the way one rim locked into the next, so that a whole rank interlocked into a wall that could move; the shieldmen stood close together, the long spear reached out above the shield line, and the short weapons struck from behind. It must be said that the Roman state had been gone since the fifth century, and no such shield appeared on a battlefield in the Jianghuai in 617; what the two sides actually carried were Chinese-style shields and spears. Sui foot soldiers used round shields and square shields, most of them covered in hide or lacquered, and paired them with ring-pommel knives and straight sabres; picked foot and cavalry used the long spear and the cavalry lance, and their armour was the bright-plated brigandine with a helmet and lamellar skirt. Bows and crossbows were split between the composite bow and the hand crossbow, and the powerful drawn and bed crossbows were carried both in the field and on the wall; in the water country there were river boats, iron-headed rams, pole-beaters and towered warships, while sieges used scaling ladders, battering rams and stone-throwers and defences used plastered crenellations, timber galleries and cheval-de-frise. Fire-raising materials such as torches and oil were of the first importance against reed marshes and river craft. Grain, replacements and reinforcements all travelled by the canal, so that whoever held the crossings and the depots along the Hangou canal held the campaign.
tactics: 杜伏威的戰法是一整套利用江淮水網的野戰辦法。他不急於攻取城池，而是先在鄉野與水網地帶消耗朝廷的精兵：起義初期靠流動與襲擾，專挑蘆葦、沼澤、堤岸一類不便騎兵展開的地形設伏，點火焚燒宋顥部便是其一例；對隋將公孫上哲與陳稜，也都是把決戰地點安排在隋軍離城、縱隊行進的途中，再以集中兵力一次咬住。兵力運用上，杜伏威主張合兵不分散，擊敗一部即乘勢擴張，不追遠、不浪費糧秣；同時切斷運河沿線的糧道與渡口，令隋軍的糧秣、援兵與退路都受牽制。隋軍這邊，陳稜依托江都與高郵的城防，依靠運河漕運維持遠征兵力的補給，試圖以騎兵與弩陣掃平江北，再逐步向北推進；然而江南多河多湖，騎兵難以展開，糧道又遭切斷，縱深作戰的優勢盡失，一旦野戰失利，後方又無援兵可退。
tacticsEn: Du Fuwei's method was a whole way of fighting in the open that exploited the water network of the Jianghuai. He was in no hurry to take cities; his aim was to wear down the court's picked troops in the countryside and among the waterways first. In the early years his movement and harassment were his main weapons, and he chose ground of reeds, marsh and embankment where cavalry could not deploy, burning Song Hao's men in a reed bed being the classic example. Against Gong Sun Shangzhe and Chen Leng alike, he fixed the place of decision where the Sui army was on the road, out of its cities and stretched out in column, and then closed on it with his concentrated force. In the use of troops Du held that all his strength should be kept together rather than scattered: once a part of the enemy was beaten he expanded at once on the strength of it, neither chasing far nor wasting grain. At the same time he cut the supply route and the crossings along the canal, so that the Sui army's grain, its reinforcements and its line of retreat were all constrained. On the Sui side, Chen Leng leaned on the defences of Jiangdu and Gaoyou and on canal transport to feed an army operating far from home, and tried to clear the north bank with cavalry and crossbow formations before pushing further; but the country south of the Yangtze is full of rivers and lakes, cavalry cannot find room to manoeuvre, the supply route had been cut, and the advantage of depth was lost, so that once the field battle was lost there was no relief army behind to fall back on.
data: 本役可查的數字有限，只能列出有依據的部分。時間是隋大業十三年（617）秋，具體月日史無明文；繫年的骨架是：大業十二年（616）七月隋虎牙郎將公孫上哲率軍鎮壓，戰於鹽城，全軍覆沒；次年杜伏威擊敗名將陳稜率領的隋軍，乘勝破高郵，之後在淮南的歷陽自稱總管，以輔公祏為長史。杜伏威生於583年，卒於武德六年三月廿七日（公元623年5月2日），虛歲四十一；貞觀五年（631）以國公禮葬於雍州萬年縣義善鄉少陵原。地理上，六合、江都（今揚州）、鹽城、高郵、歷陽（今安徽和縣）串成淮南與運河的一條線，六合至高郵約六十餘公里，歷陽至高郵約一百公里；隋軍若自江都北上或自淮陰南下，沿線任何一處渡口失守都會切斷糧道。兵員數字則無明文：起義初期杜伏威只有數十至數百人，至617年已據江淮多縣，兵力當以萬計，而陳稜所領為中樞精兵加沿途郡兵，名冊無存。此類戰役的斬首俘虜數字多帶宣傳色彩，本役記載反而簡略，不宜硬湊確數。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked for this campaign are few, and only the sourced ones can be given. The time is the autumn of the thirteenth year of Daye (617); the exact month and day are not recorded. The skeleton of the chronology is this: in the seventh month of the twelfth year of Daye (616) the tiger-tooth langjiang Gong Sun Shangzhe was sent out to put down the rebels and was fought at Yancheng, where his whole force was destroyed; in the following year Du Fuwei defeated the Sui army led by the famous general Chen Leng, rode on that victory to take Gaoyou, and afterwards proclaimed himself zongguan at Liyang in the Huai country, with Fu Gongshi as his changshi. Du Fuwei was born in 583 and died on the twenty-seventh day of the third month of the sixth year of Wude, which is 2 May 623, at the age of forty-one by Chinese reckoning; in the fifth year of Zhenguan (631) he was buried with the honours of a duke at Shaolingyuan in Yishanxiang, Wannian county, Yong prefecture. Geographically, Liuhe, Jiangdu (present-day Yangzhou), Yancheng, Gaoyou and Liyang (present-day He county in Anhui) string out along one line of the Huai country and the canal; Liuhe to Gaoyou is a little over sixty kilometres and Liyang to Gaoyou about a hundred. If the Sui marched north from Jiangdu or south from Huaiyin, the loss of any one crossing on that line would cut the supply route. Figures for numbers of men are not recorded: Du Fuwei began with perhaps several dozen or a few hundred men, and by 617 he held many counties of the Jianghuai with a force that must have numbered in the thousands or tens of thousands, while the army Chen Leng led was the central picked troops reinforced by county levies, and no roster survives. Casualty and prisoner figures in battles of this kind usually carry a strong flavour of proclamation; in this campaign the record is thin rather than inflated, and it would be wrong to invent exact numbers.
cause: 打起來有三重原因。第一是隋朝在江淮的榨取：大業年間連年東征高句麗，江淮是漕運軍糧、輸送甲士的通道，租調力役急徵，民間已不堪其苦。第二是地方秩序崩壞：州郡的官府倚靠郡兵維持，盜賊蜂起，隋廷的政令早已出不了城郭，杜伏威的起義隊伍在江淮鄉村之間流動，追隨者眾，兵源不缺。第三是杜伏威的實力已直接威脅運河與江都：起義軍屯兵六合、破鹽城，進可擾江都、退可守江北，隋廷不可能再容忍，於是派出以名將陳稜為主、兵精器利的鎮壓大軍，企圖一舉把江淮的反抗壓平。與此同時，隋廷自身正處在最壞的時候：潼關方向被李密逼壓，江都一帶的防務抽不出成建制的重兵，於是這一戰的勝負，幾乎全押在一次野戰的結果上。
causeEn: There were three reasons for the fighting. The first was the way the Sui was squeezing the Jianghuai: with campaigns against Goguryeo year after year in the Daye era, the region was the corridor along which military grain and troops were moved, the tax and the labour levies were called in without measure, and the people could bear no more. The second was the collapse of local order: the prefectures and counties held their posts with their own militia, bandits rose on every side, the court's writ no longer reached beyond the city walls, and Du Fuwei's bands moved among the villages of the Jianghuai, drawing followers as they went, so that he had no lack of recruits. The third was that Du's strength now threatened the canal and Jiangdu directly. His troops sat at Liuhe, he had smashed Yancheng, he could disturb Jiangdu by moving forward and fall back into the north bank to defend; the court could not tolerate this, and so it sent out a large and well-equipped suppression army under the famous general Chen Leng, hoping to crush the rising in the Jianghuai in one stroke. At the same time the Sui court itself was in the worst possible condition: it was being pressed by Li Mi toward Tongguan, and the defence of the Jiangdu region could no longer produce any substantial body of troops for the field, so the whole outcome of this campaign came down to the result of a single battle in the open.
impact: 陳稜一敗，隋廷在江淮最後一次有力的反撲宣告失敗。這一場之後，長江下游北岸的局勢再也回不到隋廷手中：杜伏威乘勝破高郵、取歷陽，兵鋒及於江北各縣；大業十四年（618），他見隋室已在崩解，轉而向洛陽的越王楊侗稱臣，被封楚王，拜東道大總管，把一個起義首領的地位做成了隋廷名器。往後江南的統一，實際上是在這批江淮武力之上完成的：武德二年（619）杜伏威歸唐，封吳王、賜姓李；次年擊敗李子通，把治所遷到丹陽；其後唐廷在江南的處置，都是拿杜伏威的降眾與地盤作基礎。對杜伏威本人，這場勝利既是巔峰也是隱患：他的兵眾大半是在對隋的戰陣裡養出來的，又靠恩賞立威，部眾只認他一人而不認朝廷，武德六年輔公祏之變即由此而生；兵敗被殺，杜伏威同年憂懼而亡，集團就此解散，江淮的軍力全數併入唐的編制，隋末唐初江南的戰力從此換了主人。
impactEn: With Chen Leng's defeat the Sui court's last serious counter-stroke in the Jianghuai failed. After this battle the situation on the north bank of the lower Yangtze never returned to the court's hands: Du Fuwei rode the victory on to take Gaoyou and Liyang, and his arms reached the counties of the north bank. In 618, seeing that the Sui was coming apart, he changed sides and submitted to the Prince of Yue Yang Tong at Luoyang, was made Prince of Chu and appointed Grand Commander of the Eastern Circuit, and turned the position of a rebel chief into an honoured title of the dying court. The later unification of the south was in fact built on the military force of this Jianghuai army: in the second year of Wude (619) Du Fuwei went over to the Tang and was made Prince of Wu with the surname Li conferred on him; the next year he defeated Li Zitong and moved his seat to Danyang; and everything the Tang court then did in Jiangnan was founded on the surrendered men and the ground Du Fuwei had held. For Du himself the victory was at once his high point and his danger: most of his soldiers had been hardened in the fighting against the Sui, and his authority rested on rewards and goodwill, so that the men followed him alone and not the court. That is what produced Fu Gongshi's rising in the sixth year of Wude; defeated and killed, Du Fuwei died of fear in the same year, the group dissolved, and the whole military strength of the Jianghuai was folded into the Tang order of battle, the fighting power of Jiangnan changing hands at the turn of the dynasty.
result: 結果是隋軍大敗，史稱陳稜僅以身免，所部精兵折損甚重，隋廷此後再無力大舉進兵江淮。杜伏威乘勝破高郵，進取歷陽，自稱總管，以輔公祏為長史整頓軍政，把此前散處各處的起義部伍併為一軍，江淮各縣多歸其節制。這一役之後，隋、江淮起義軍、唐三方在江南的三角競逐一改變：陳稜兵敗退保，隋廷在江南的號令只剩下形式；杜伏威成為江南事實上的支配者，先稱楚王，再於武德二年降唐為吳王；唐廷則以招撫與合作的方式，把江淮的兵與地一次過收編入朝。此後江南的格局，幾乎就是這場戰鬥畫下的底稿。須要說明的是，本役的具體戰場、交戰序列、點名數字與雙方傷亡，現存史料只留下骨架，細節仍有待出土文書與地方志補全。
resultEn: The result was a severe defeat for the Sui army. The histories say that Chen Leng escaped with nothing more than his life, that the picked troops of his command were broken, and that the Sui court was never again in a position to drive a large army into the Jianghuai. Du Fuwei rode the victory on to take Gaoyou, advanced to Liyang, proclaimed himself zongguan, and set Fu Gongshi as changshi to put the army in order, merging the rebel bands that had until then been scattered over many places into a single force, and most of the counties of the Jianghuai came under his control. After this battle the triangular contest between the Sui, the Jianghuai rebels and the Tang in the south changed on every side: Chen Leng was defeated and fell back, and the Sui court's authority in the south remained only in form; Du Fuwei became the effective master of the south of the Yangtze, first as Prince of Chu and then, in the second year of Wude, as Prince of Wu by submission to the Tang; and the Tang court, by a policy of amnesty and cooperation, took over the men and the ground of the Jianghuai in a single stroke. The arrangement of the south after this campaign is very nearly the outline drawn by this battle. It should be said that the exact battlefield, the order of the fighting, the named casualty figures and the losses on both sides survive in the records only as a skeleton, and the detail still has to be filled in from excavated documents and local gazetteers.
